purpose: Fresh reproduction of the frozen-state binary diagnostic; never overwrite the published evidence.

placeholders.REPO: Absolute checkout containing this archive and the corresponding source implementation, with recursive notorch submodule initialized.
placeholders.FRESH_REF: A new empty absolute scratch directory. Copy helpers listed below there.
placeholders.NEW_AUDIT: A fresh independent numerical/source review receipt, not a historical receipt relabeled as current.
placeholders.NEW_RESULTS_DIRECTORY: A new absolute output directory for the reproduced archive; it must not already exist and must differ from the published archive.

commands.step: Build native extractor/probe/solver and execute regression gates
Prepare system/user-only input, metadata and fixed masks
Prepare full-gold data solely for independent extractor/cache parity
commands.limit: The production extractor never opens this file. The parity gate alone uses it.

commands.step: Freeze after fresh source review and all native gates
Run recorded native phases and aggregate saved predictions
Collect completed evidence into a new result directory

execution_notes: Command argv entries and environment values use literal placeholders above; substitute absolute paths before execution. They are structured instructions, not a shell script.

Make uses -march=native when available and the active compiler. Different CPU/compiler/libm versions can change executable hashes and floating-point outputs. Fresh plans bind fresh executable hashes; do not relax failed numerical criteria after inspecting results.

A run directory is allowed to contain prepared inputs before execution; declared streams and phase-created outputs must not already exist. A failed attempt is retained and cannot be silently resumed under the same filenames.

C performs model inference, feature normalization, Newton optimization and scores/probabilities/class predictions. Python serializes inputs, prepares lexical counts, checks provenance, and aggregates saved prediction counts and permutation references.

All six phases are fixed by bind_readout_v2.py: causal parity, prompt-only extraction, nuisance serialization, state head fitting, nuisance head fitting, summary. Native numerical or convergence failure prevents completed archive creation.
Each view has 20 family holdouts times 100 label sets plus two in-sample interpolation fits. This is 2002 fits per view, not 2002 independently sampled datasets.
The 52-by-896 state file and 52-by-7 nuisance file contain float32 features with explicit headers. All fitted coefficients and intercepts remain unexported; no new generative checkpoint is produced.
The fixed common prefix is supplied; the diagnostic does not assess natural JSON entry or generated reasons/citations. Historical full-review outcomes are context only.
historical_paths: Archive files retain original absolute paths. Run copied helper sources with fresh arguments; do not edit historical receipts to make their old paths appear current.

historical_failed_attempt.status: The first attempt failed in its native parity gate before feature extraction or classifier fitting. Its textual assertion wrongly said the three fixed IDs spell {"findings":; they spell {"findings. The guard text was corrected without changing the three IDs or statistical design.
historical_failed_attempt.source_snapshot: Original source, exact inputs, plan and failure receipts are preserved. The local-snapshot manifest also lists three compiled executables; the top-level archive manifest explicitly records their omission from the public archive.
historical_failed_attempt.binary_limit: Exact old binary bytes remain only in the local snapshot. Rebuilding the archived failing source reproduces the guard condition; compiler/CPU differences may change executable hashes.
